title: Argentinian Chicken Wings
description: Tender and juicy chicken wings marinated in a zesty Argentinian-inspired sauce, perfect for a flavorful and satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.notes: Minced and mixed with bowl seasoning

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, Argentinian bowl seasoning, garlic, chili flakes (if using), salt, and black pepper.
Add chicken wings to the marinade and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Remove chicken from the marinade and shake off excess.
Grill chicken wings for 20-25 minutes or until cooked through, flipping halfway through.
While chicken is grilling, mix together lime juice and salt in a small bowl.
Once chicken is cooked, brush with lime juice mixture and serve with quenched yogurt (if using) and additional lime wedges on the side.
Let chicken rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Adjust seasoning as needed before serving.
